origin.description: Newton iteration for a nonlinear system, with a numerical Jacobian by default.
origin.usage: newtonsys(Ffun, x0, Jfun = NULL, ..., maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5)

arguments.name: Jfun
arguments.text: Jacobian. The numerical Jacobian is used when omitted.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Stop when the step or the residual is small.

origin.value: Newton iteration for a nonlinear system, with a numerical Jacobian by default.
origin.example: with(newtonsys(function(z) c(z[1]^2 - 1, z[2] - 2), c(0.5, 1)), c(zero, fnorm, niter))

translation.description: Newton iteration for a nonlinear system, with a numerical Jacobian by default.
translation.usage: newtonsys(Ffun, x0, Jfun = NULL, ..., maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5)

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Stop when the step or the residual is small.

translation.value: Newton iteration for a nonlinear system, with a numerical Jacobian by default.
translation.example: (lambda z: np.concatenate([z['zero'], [z['fnorm'], z['niter']]]))(newtonsys(lambda z: np.array([z[0]**2 - 1, z[1] - 2]), [0.5, 1]))
